articles.title: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack
FBI says North Korea behind $6 billion Binance crypto theft

events.summary: The FBI stated that North Korea was behind a $6.3 billion hack targeting crypto firm Binance. Binance has reportedly covered 90% of the incurred losses.
events.why: A multi-billion dollar state-sponsored cyber theft fuels illicit state funding and highlights severe vulnerabilities in crypto asset infrastructure.

articles.title: Global nature talks reach deal but money remains an issue

events.summary: Global nature negotiations concluded with an agreement to curb biodiversity decline, though funding unresolved questions remain. Participating nations continue working to solidify mechanisms to halt ecological deterioration.
events.why: Global biodiversity treaties establish conservation targets, but lack of committed funding frequently compromises implementation.

articles.title: Binance resumes customer withdrawals after record $6.3bn hack

events.summary: Binance has resumed customer withdrawals following a record $6.3 billion cyber theft. The FBI identified North Korean hackers as the perpetrators of the heist.
events.why: The resumption of withdrawals eases systemic liquidity concerns following one of the largest cyber heists on record.

articles.title: How the downfall of Serbia's Vučiċ mirrored that of Hungary's Orbán

events.summary: Serbia's leader Aleksandar Vučić suffered an electoral defeat in last weekend's vote. The outcome closely mirrored the previous political downfall of Viktor Orbán in Hungary.
events.why: Electoral defeats of long-standing entrenched leaders reshape regional alliances and governance across Central and Eastern Europe.

articles.title: Tusk defends overhaul of Poland’s constitutional court despite protests

events.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk announced he will proceed with a contentious overhaul of Poland's constitutional court despite ongoing protests. He stated that the reform is necessary to restore a tribunal impaired by political conflict.
events.why: Restructuring a nation's constitutional court directly alters judicial independence and the balance of constitutional power.

articles.title: Northern Territory water plan condemned as ‘blatant and shameless’ attack on nature

events.summary: The Northern Territory government has proposed scrapping the legal requirement to set aside water for the environment. Environmental groups have condemned the plan as an extreme attack on nature.
events.why: Removing environmental water protections can deplete regional water resources and cause lasting ecological degradation.

articles.title: Shops looted as German cost-of-living protests turn violent

events.summary: Cost-of-living protests turned violent across German cities including Berlin, Hamburg, and Frankfurt, resulting in shops being looted. The demonstrations occurred simultaneously with large-scale protests in France.
events.why: Widespread civil unrest driven by economic pressures can disrupt public safety and trigger wider political instability across Europe.

articles.title: Ethiopian PM puts ministers through military training

events.summary: Ethiopia's prime minister has required government ministers to undergo military training. The initiative aligns with his stated policy emphasizing military preparedness as core to his administration's goals.
events.why: Militarizing civilian cabinet members signals a notable shift toward centralized military focus within the executive branch.

articles.title: 'We came back from hell', say Ukrainians after years in Russia-occupied front-line city

events.summary: Evacuated Ukrainians from the Russian-occupied front-line city of Oleshky reported navigating minefields to find food during their confinement. Former residents described surviving severe hardships before their escape.
events.why: The account documents the critical humanitarian dangers and extreme risks faced by civilians residing in contested occupied territories.

articles.title: Ukrainian evacuees reunite with family after years trapped in Russia-occupied city

events.summary: Residents from Oleshky reunited with family members after living trapped under Russian occupation without power, water, or food. Many survivors had resorted to cooking garden weeds to endure the conditions.
events.why: The report highlights the collapse of basic survival infrastructure for civilian populations isolated in occupied war zones.
